title: ISKCON Baroda - A Spiritual Oasis of Peace and Devotion
content:
ISKCON Baroda,

Located in the peaceful Gotri area of Vadodara, the ISKCON Baroda Temple, also known as the Sri Sri Radha Shyamasundar Mandir, is one of Gujarat’s most beautiful centers of spirituality and devotion. Managed by the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON), the temple attracts thousands of devotees and visitors from all over India who come to experience divine serenity, soulful chants, and traditional wisdom.

About the Temple

The ISKCON Baroda Temple is dedicated to Lord Krishna and Radha, and promotes the teachings of Bhagavad Gita and Bhakti Yoga (the path of devotion). The temple’s architecture reflects a blend of modern design and traditional Vaishnav art, featuring intricate carvings, colorful murals, and idols of Radha Shyamasundar, Lord Jagannath, Baladeva, and Subhadra.

Every corner of the temple radiates positive energy - from the echoing chants of Hare Krishna to the calming presence of devotees engaged in kirtan and meditation.

Spiritual Experience and Activities

Visiting ISKCON Baroda is more than just a temple visit - it’s a spiritual experience. The temple conducts daily aartis, kirtans, bhajans, and Gita study classes that deepen one’s understanding of Krishna consciousness.

The Sunday Feast Program is especially popular, where devotees gather to enjoy spiritual talks, devotional music, and prasadam (sanctified food) served to all visitors. The temple also organizes Janmashtami celebrations with grandeur, featuring special decorations, devotional performances, and chanting sessions that attract huge crowds.

Architecture and Ambience

The temple’s design emphasizes peace and purity. Surrounded by green lawns and marble pathways, the white domes and lotus motifs create an atmosphere of calmness and divine beauty. Inside, the main altar shines with beautifully adorned deities of Sri Sri Radha Shyamasundar, making it a perfect spot for meditation and inner reflection.

Govinda’s Restaurant and Gift Shop

The temple premises also include Govinda’s Restaurant, which serves delicious sattvic vegetarian meals and sweets. There’s also a gift shop selling spiritual books, souvenirs, and devotional items for those wishing to take a part of ISKCON’s teachings home.

Location

ISKCON Temple, Gotri Road, Vadodara, Gujarat - 390021

Timings

  • Morning: 4:30 AM - 1:00 PM
  • Evening: 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Aarti Timings:

  • Mangala Aarti: 4:30 AM
  • Sandhya Aarti: 7:00 PM

Entry Fee

Free entry for all visitors.

How to Reach

  • By Air: Vadodara Airport is about 10 km away.
  • By Train: Vadodara Junction is around 7 km from the temple.
  • By Road: Easily accessible by taxi, auto-rickshaw, or local bus from any part of the city.

Nearby Attractions

  • EME Temple - A modern architectural masterpiece dedicated to Lord Shiva. Read more..
  • Sursagar Lake - A peaceful spot for evening relaxation.

faqs.question: Where is ISKCON Baroda located?
faqs.answer: ISKCON Baroda is located near Gotri Road in Vadodara, Gujarat, easily accessible from the city center.

faqs.question: What are the temple timings?
faqs.answer: The temple is usually open from 4:30 AM to 1:00 PM and again from 4:00 PM to 8:30 PM, but it’s best to check before visiting.

faqs.question: Is there any entry fee for visiting ISKCON Baroda?
faqs.answer: No, entry to ISKCON Baroda is free for all visitors.

faqs.question: Why is ISKCON Baroda famous for?
faqs.answer: It’s known for its peaceful atmosphere, beautiful idols of Radha-Krishna, devotional music, and spiritual lectures.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit ISKCON Baroda?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit is during Janmashtami or Radhashtami, when the temple is beautifully decorated and hosts grand celebrations.
